title: サイコーのアタシたち

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket has left her mark on the Twinkle Series, achieving results to be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we've successfully navigated the crucial first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm reflecting on everything we've achieved on the way to this major turning point…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Traaaineeer! Can you hide me somewhere? Just for a little?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm playing hide-and-seek with Taishin and Hayahide, but I absolutely, positively can't lose this round!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Of course it is! Always give your best shot at everything, no matter how big or small! That's how BNW does things!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They may have been competitive when it comes to training and races, but I don't recall them making a big deal out of little things like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So I ask for details from Ticket, and she puffs up with pride as she explains away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few minutes earlier…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide! Taishin! I challenge you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We're rivals, after all! We gotta have a super competitive spirit at all times!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh, what's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's probably some influence from a manga she happened to read.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Competing fiercely… pushing each other to reach new heights… And before we know it, we'll have forged unbreakable bonds of friendship!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's why we gotta motivate each other to be at our best—constantly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how the three of them ended up playing hide-and-seek. Narita Taishin, who lost at rock-paper-scissors, is on the hunt for the other two.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: She found Hayahide already—I'm the only one left! So I gotta try twice as hard!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Anyway, just hide me from Taishin, Trainer! PLEASE!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So Winning Ticket dives underneath my desk, and mere moments later…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ticket? You in here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Meh, whatever. Let me take a break here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a quick glance around the office, Narita Taishin casually picks up a notebook from the desk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Winning Ticket's race agenda from last year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Last year's agenda, huh? The Osaka Hai, the Takarazuka Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's when Ticket wasn't doing so well…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Biwa Hayahide whispers, Narita Taishin lowers her voice as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: To be honest, back then I thought she would've been better off just quitting—especially around the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, she got out of her funk, so it's fine now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh. I knew you were worried about her, in your own way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? Like you weren't? I remember you going on about how you missed our "exhilarating showdowns."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's true. Racing you both is the best form of training I can wish for.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geez, don't you feel even a little embarrassed saying this stuff?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching the two of them talk so fondly, my heart warms with the memories of their heated races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There were times they were distant or clashed, but both of them watched over Winning Ticket together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, forget it. It's not like I ever tried to take things into my own hands the way Hayahide did.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I also was simply worried, nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The reason why Ticket recovered was because she's always had the adaptability and strength to do so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaah! You guuuuys!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank you, thank you, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm sooo glad I came to the academy and met you twooo! Sniffle!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I knew you were here.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank y—huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: My strategy worked. I win, and our game of hide-and-seek is over.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? You WIN?! Wait, no… WHY?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Dear me… She's as awkward at expressing her feelings as ever. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I should be going too. I need to return a book I borrowed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: They're gone…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Heh heh heh heh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I dunno, I'm just… so happy about all that stuff they said! Even if I didn't really get half of it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And you know, if it weren't for them, I don't think I'd ever have been able to run such amazing races!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm really happy I came to Tracen Academy and met those two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Over our past three years together, Winning Ticket's friends have played a huge role in giving her the inspiration she needed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure they'll continue to stick by Winning Ticket's side, providing a positive influence on her for years to come.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, and I can't forget to say this! I also met the best trainer I could've asked for!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haha! Let's keep going for it together—okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On this calm afternoon, it feels like my days of working together with Winning Ticket are beginning anew.
